chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Musa al-Daqqaq (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Harun al-Sufi narrated to us. He said: Abu Turab Ubaydullah ibn Musa al-Ruwyani narrated to us from Abd al-Azim ibn Abdullah al-Hasani. He said: I said to Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Rida (peace be upon him): O son of the Messenger of Allah! Narrate a hadith to me from your forefathers (peace be upon them).

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The people will continue in goodness as long as there is variance among them; when they are equalized, they will perish. He said: I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Were the veil lifted from you, you would not wish to be buried. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: You cannot accommodate the people with your wealth, so accommodate them with a cheerful face and good reception. For I heard the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah upon him and his family) say: You cannot accommodate the people with your wealth, so accommodate them with your character. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever blames time will prolong his own regret. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Sitting with the wicked begets suspicion toward the righteous. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The worst provision for the Hereafter is aggression against God's servants. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: The worth of every person is in what he excels at. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: A person is hidden beneath his tongue. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: No person who knows his own worth will perish. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Planning before acting will protect you from regret. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever places trust in time will be thrown down. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): He who relies solely on his own opinion risks himself. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Having few dependents is one of the two forms of ease. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is overcome by self-conceit will perish. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is certain of divine recompense will be generous in giving. So I said to him: Tell me more, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

So he said: My father narrated to me from my grandfather, from his forefathers (peace be upon them): Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: Whoever is content with well-being from those beneath him will be granted safety from those above him.
He said: So I said to him: This is sufficient for me.

key_terms.الْخَلَفُ: Divine recompense — replacement/compensation given by God for what one gives in charity
key_terms.الْعُجْبُ: Self-conceit, vanity — one of the most condemned spiritual diseases
key_terms.الْمَعَادُ: The Return — the Hereafter, the final destination
key_terms.تَفَاوَتُوا: They differed/varied — diversity in human abilities and circumstances
key_terms.تَكَاشَفْتُمْ: Were the veil lifted — if hidden spiritual states were revealed
key_terms.طَلَاقَةُ الْوَجْهِ: Cheerful countenance, a bright and welcoming face

ai.seo_question: What wisdom sayings did Imam al-Jawad narrate from Imam Ali in Amali al-Saduq?
ai.summary: This hadith records a remarkable session in which Abd al-Azim al-Hasani visited Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (AS) and requested hadith after hadith from his forefathers, receiving sixteen distinct wisdom sayings attributed to Imam Ali (AS). The sayings span a wide range of ethical and social guidance: the importance of diversity in society, the fear of having one's spiritual state exposed, the power of good character over wealth, the futility of blaming fate, the dangers of bad company, the severity of oppression, the value of self-knowledge, the importance of foresight, the danger of arrogance, and the virtue of generosity. Imam al-Jawad (AS) transmitted each saying through the same chain: from his father al-Rida (AS), from his grandfather al-Kadhim (AS), from their forefathers, all the way back to Imam Ali (AS). This format illustrates the living transmission of prophetic wisdom across the Imams.
word_analysis: were the veil lifted from you/you revealed yourselves
